_template: FAQPage — ONLY where a visible FAQ block exists on the page (5-8 Q&A in Hebrew).
_inputs: visible FAQ questions and answers, verbatim from the page
_notes: Google restricted FAQ rich results to authoritative gov/health sites, but the markup still helps other engines and AI answer engines (Bing, ChatGPT, Perplexity).
The markup MUST reflect exactly the FAQ text visible on the page — no hidden or extra questions.
Each calculator page has a 6-item FAQ; compare/best pages have 5-8. Only emit FAQPage where those blocks render.
